label: CUMULATIVE_LEARNING

optionalProps.routine_rigidity: number (0-1) — 演化经济学的惯例刚性参数

diagnostic_signals.learning_stall: learning_rate < 0.05 AND cumulative_output > baseline — 学习曲线平坦化
diagnostic_signals.rigidity_lock: routine_rigidity > 0.8 AND learning_rate_declining — 惯例刚性阻碍学习

description: 累积学习曲线——单位成本随累计产出下降。学术基础：Wright's Law(1936)+Nelson-Winter(1982)演化经济学。数据来源：PRODUCES边output/quantity + Financial节点cost/cogs。
